source_title: 와틀딱들이 명심해야 할 점: 알아도 모른 척 하기
subtitle: 탱커보다 먼저 달려가 3무리 애드 내는 고인물 훈수 냥꾼

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
던전 시작! 천천히 갈게,
내가 한 무리씩 풀링한다!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle dungeon corridor start shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style. Full-body head-to-boots framing inside generous pure #FFFFFF margins on all 4 edges with ONLY tiny self-contained stone floor ovals under boots (never full-width ground strips, walls, doorways, or edge-touching rocks), zero text, letters, digits, SFX, panel borders, or speech bubbles. On the left, steady Orc Warrior protection tank (fair peach skin, never green skin, green plush orc hood with TWO curved ivory horns, jet-black ponytail and bangs, crimson eyes, EXACTLY TWO arms, holding ONLY ONE 1H sword pointed calmly ahead and ONE sturdy steel kite shield with outer armored face facing forward; strictly zero battle axe and zero second sword) leads with a focused confident grin. On the right, relieved Tauren Druid (brown plush cow hood with ivory horns and gold nose ring, brown bangs and eyes, leafy-green shoulder mantle, suede tunic, leafy wooden staff stowed neatly on her back) smiles warmly giving a cheerful empty-hand thumbs-up.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
요즘 누가 그렇게 가?

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:

탱커님 어글 꽉 잡으세요!
